---
title: "09 方法 2 vs 1 配对差异捕获"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r init, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="prepare"}
PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE <- get0("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", inherits = TRUE,
  ifnotfound = Sys.getenv("PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE", unset = "describe"))
stopifnot(PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE %in% c("describe", "differential", "enrichment"))
OUTPUT_FIG_DIR <- CAPTURE_FIG
OUTPUT_TAB_DIR <- CAPTURE_TAB
prepare_module_outputs(OUTPUT_FIG_DIR, OUTPUT_TAB_DIR, c("01_design_qc", "02_category", "03_subtype", "04_annotation", "05_sequence"))
activate_serum_context(environment(), analysis_scope = "method_comparison")
if (!pkg_has("edgeR") || !pkg_has("limma")) stop("模块 9 需要 edgeR 和 limma。")
PANDORA_CAN_PCA <- nrow(sample_info) >= 3L
pandora_group_n <- table(as.character(sample_info$Group))
pandora_paired_rows <- sample_info %>%
  filter(as.character(Method) %in% c("1", "2"), !is.na(PairID), PairID != "")
pandora_pair_membership <- table(pandora_paired_rows$PairID, as.character(pandora_paired_rows$Method))
PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE <- nrow(pandora_paired_rows) == 6L &&
  identical(dim(pandora_pair_membership), c(3L, 2L)) && all(pandora_pair_membership == 1L)
write_csv_safe(tibble(
  AnalysisStage = PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE,
  AnalysisScope = get0("analysis_scope", inherits = TRUE, ifnotfound = "all"),
  LibraryN = nrow(sample_info), GroupN = length(pandora_group_n),
  PCAApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_PCA, GroupComparisonApplicable = PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE
), "analysis_stage_status.csv")

```

# 分析边界

本模块只比较 2 号供体中方法 1 与方法 2 的三个严格匹配分装。统计模型中的 `PairID` 吸收分装及其嵌套 batch 差异；正 log2FC 表示方法 2 捕获信号高于方法 1。结果只代表该供体和本次技术流程，不做人群层面生物学推断。

```{r design, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
capture_samples <- sample_info %>%
  filter(as.character(Method) %in% c("1", "2"), PairID != "") %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    MethodFactor = factor(as.character(Method), levels = c("1", "2")),
    PairFactor = factor(PairID)
  ) %>%
  arrange(PairFactor, MethodFactor)

if (nrow(capture_samples) != 6L || n_distinct(capture_samples$PairID) != 3L ||
    any(count(capture_samples, PairID)$n != 2L)) {
  stop("差异捕获设计必须恰好包含 6 个库和 3 个匹配 PairID。")
}

capture_design <- stats::model.matrix(~ PairFactor + MethodFactor, data = capture_samples)
rownames(capture_design) <- capture_samples$Sample
if (qr(capture_design)$rank != 4L || nrow(capture_design) - qr(capture_design)$rank != 2L) {
  stop("配对设计矩阵必须 rank=4 且 residual df=2。")
}
method_coef <- grep("^MethodFactor2$", colnames(capture_design))
if (length(method_coef) != 1L) stop("未能在设计矩阵中定位方法 2 vs 1 系数。")

capture_design_export <- bind_cols(
  capture_samples %>% transmute(Sample, Method = as.character(Method), PairID, Replicate, Batch),
  as_tibble(capture_design)
)
write_csv_safe(capture_design_export, "capture_design_matrix.csv")
write_csv_safe(
  tibble(
    Contrast = "method2_vs_method1", Model = "~ PairID + Method",
    SampleN = 6L, PairN = 3L, DonorN = 1L,
    DesignRank = qr(capture_design)$rank,
    ResidualDF = nrow(capture_design) - qr(capture_design)$rank,
    SignificanceMetric = de_significance_label(), Cutoff = 0.05,
    AbsoluteLog2FCCutoff = log2(1.5),
    Interpretation = "paired technical differential capture; single-donor process inference only"
  ),
  "capture_contrast_manifest.csv"
)
```

```{r inputs, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
sample_order <- capture_samples$Sample
general_annotation_categories <- intersect(
  c("miRNA", "piRNA", "ysRNA", "lncRNA", "snRNA", "snoRNA", "scaRNA", "misc_RNA", "vault_RNA", "ribozyme", "other"),
  category_levels
)

category_input <- summary_top %>%
  transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Feature = as.character(MainCategory), Reads)

subtype_input <- bind_rows(
  summary_all %>%
    filter(SubClass != "-", !MainCategory %in% c("tsRNA", "rsRNA"), !Class %in% c("Clean_Reads", "Match_Genome")) %>%
    transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Feature = paste0(as.character(MainCategory), "::", as.character(SubClass)), Reads),
  tsrna_base_detail %>%
    transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Feature = paste0("tsRNA::", BaseSubClass), Reads),
  rsrna_detail %>%
    transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Feature = paste0("rsRNA::", RsRNAClass), Reads)
)

annotation_counts <- sports_annotation_counts(summary_all, clean_reads_tbl)
annotation_input <- annotation_counts %>%
  filter(
    FeatureCategory %in% general_annotation_categories,
    !is.na(PrimaryAnnotation), PrimaryAnnotation != "", PrimaryAnnotation != "NO_Annotation"
  ) %>%
  transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Feature = as.character(PrimaryAnnotation), Reads)

sequence_input <- output_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "", Reads > 0) %>%
  transmute(Sample = as.character(Sample), Feature = as.character(Sequence), Reads)

feature_metadata <- list(
  category = tibble(Feature = category_levels, FeatureCategory = category_levels),
  subtype = subtype_input %>% distinct(Feature) %>% mutate(FeatureCategory = sub("::.*$", "", Feature)),
  annotation = annotation_counts %>%
    filter(FeatureCategory %in% general_annotation_categories, PrimaryAnnotation != "NO_Annotation") %>%
    transmute(Feature = as.character(PrimaryAnnotation), FeatureCategory = as.character(FeatureCategory)) %>%
    distinct(),
  sequence = output_all %>%
    filter(!is.na(Sequence), Sequence != "") %>%
    transmute(
      Feature = as.character(Sequence),
      FeatureCategory = as.character(FeatureCategory),
      TopAnnotation = as.character(Annotation),
      Length = nchar(Sequence)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Feature) %>%
    summarise(
      FeatureCategory = first(FeatureCategory), TopAnnotation = first(TopAnnotation),
      Length = first(Length), .groups = "drop"
    )
)
```

```{r capture-helper, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
run_capture_layer <- function(layer, title_text, input_df, feature_meta, section, min_total = 0) {
  matrix_info <- build_feature_count_matrix(
    input_df %>% filter(Sample %in% sample_order),
    feature_col = "Feature", sample_order = sample_order, min_total = min_total
  )
  counts <- matrix_info$matrix
  if (any(!is.finite(counts) | counts < 0)) stop("差异捕获计数必须为有限非负数: ", layer)
  if (nrow(counts) == 0) stop("无可用特征: ", layer)

  dge0 <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts)
  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(dge0, design = capture_design)
  if (!any(keep)) stop("没有特征通过 edgeR filterByExpr: ", layer)
  dge <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = counts[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  dge <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
  dge <- edgeR::estimateDisp(dge, capture_design, robust = TRUE)
  fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(dge, capture_design, robust = TRUE)
  test <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, coef = method_coef)
  base_mean_values <- rowMeans(counts, na.rm = TRUE)
  results <- edgeR::topTags(test, n = Inf)$table %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(
      baseMean = unname(base_mean_values[Feature]),
      SignificanceMetric = if (de_significance_label() == "FDR") FDR else PValue,
      SignificanceMethod = de_significance_label(),
      direction = classify_de_direction(SignificanceMetric, logFC),
      CaptureDirection = recode(direction, up = "higher_in_method2", down = "higher_in_method1", ns = "not_selected"),
      rank_score = sign(logFC) * -log10(SignificanceMetric + 1e-300),
      Layer = layer, Contrast = "method2_vs_method1",
      Interpretation = "paired technical differential capture"
    ) %>%
    left_join(feature_meta, by = "Feature") %>%
    arrange(SignificanceMetric, PValue, desc(abs(logFC)))

  logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 0.5)
  norm <- tibble(
    Layer = layer, Sample = colnames(dge),
    LibrarySize = dge$samples$lib.size,
    TMMNormalizationFactor = dge$samples$norm.factors,
    EffectiveLibrarySize = LibrarySize * TMMNormalizationFactor
  )
  filter_summary <- tibble(
    Layer = layer, FeaturesBeforeFilter = nrow(dge0), FeaturesAfterFilter = nrow(dge),
    FeaturesRemoved = nrow(dge0) - nrow(dge), FilterMethod = "edgeR::filterByExpr(design)"
  )
  dispersion <- tibble(
    Layer = layer,
    CommonDispersion = dge$common.dispersion,
    CommonBCV = sqrt(dge$common.dispersion),
    MedianTagwiseDispersion = median(dge$tagwise.dispersion, na.rm = TRUE),
    ResidualDF = nrow(capture_design) - qr(capture_design)$rank
  )

  write_csv_safe(results, file.path(section, "capture_results_method2_vs_method1.csv"))
  write_csv_safe(results %>% count(CaptureDirection, name = "FeatureN"), file.path(section, "capture_summary_method2_vs_method1.csv"))

  save_plot_nested(
    build_capture_volcano_plot(results, paste0(title_text, ": paired differential capture, method 2 vs 1"), label_n = 12),
    section, "capture_volcano_method2_vs_method1.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 6.2, view = REPORT_VIEW
  )
  save_plot_nested(
    build_capture_ma_plot(results, paste0(title_text, ": MA plot, method 2 vs 1")),
    section, "capture_ma_method2_vs_method1.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 6.2, view = REPORT_VIEW
  )

  top_features <- results %>% slice_head(n = 30) %>% pull(Feature)
  top_features <- top_features[top_features %in% rownames(logcpm)]
  if (length(top_features) >= 2 && pkg_has("pheatmap")) {
    heat_mat <- safe_scale_rows(logcpm[top_features, sample_order, drop = FALSE])
    heat_anno <- capture_samples %>%
      select(Sample, MethodFactor, PairFactor) %>%
      as.data.frame()
    rownames(heat_anno) <- heat_anno$Sample
    heat_anno$Sample <- NULL
    save_pheatmap_file(
      pmax(pmin(heat_mat, 2.5), -2.5),
      annotation_col = heat_anno,
      cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
      color = grDevices::colorRampPalette(serum_heatmap_gradient)(101),
      breaks = seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 102),
      fontsize_row = 7, fontsize_col = 9,
      main = paste0(title_text, ": row-scaled TMM logCPM"),
      filename = file.path(OUTPUT_FIG_DIR, section, "capture_top_heatmap_method2_vs_method1.pdf"),
      width = 9, height = max(5.5, 0.25 * length(top_features) + 2.5)
    )
  }
  list(results = results, dge = dge, logcpm = logcpm, norm = norm, filter = filter_summary, dispersion = dispersion)
}
```

```{r run-layers, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
capture_runs <- list(
  category = run_capture_layer("category", "RNA categories", category_input, feature_metadata$category, "02_category"),
  subtype = run_capture_layer("subtype", "RNA subtype", subtype_input, feature_metadata$subtype, "03_subtype"),
  annotation = run_capture_layer("annotation", "Annotated features", annotation_input, feature_metadata$annotation, "04_annotation"),
  sequence = run_capture_layer("sequence", "unique sequence", sequence_input, feature_metadata$sequence, "05_sequence", min_total = 5)
)

capture_all_results <- bind_rows(map(capture_runs, "results"))
capture_normalization_factors <- bind_rows(map(capture_runs, "norm"))
capture_filter_summary <- bind_rows(map(capture_runs, "filter"))
capture_dispersion_summary <- bind_rows(map(capture_runs, "dispersion"))

write_csv_safe(capture_all_results, "capture_all_results.csv")
write_csv_safe(capture_normalization_factors, "capture_normalization_factors.csv")
write_csv_safe(capture_filter_summary, "capture_filter_summary.csv")
write_csv_safe(capture_dispersion_summary, "capture_dispersion_summary.csv")
write_csv_safe(
  capture_all_results %>% filter(FeatureCategory == "miRNA"),
  "capture_miRNA_results.csv"
)
```

```{r mds-qc, include=FALSE, pandora_stage="differential", eval=PANDORA_ANALYSIS_STAGE == "differential" && PANDORA_CAN_COMPARE}
annotation_mds <- limma::plotMDS(capture_runs$annotation$dge, plot = FALSE)
mds_df <- tibble(
  Sample = colnames(capture_runs$annotation$dge),
  Dimension1 = annotation_mds$x,
  Dimension2 = annotation_mds$y
) %>%
  left_join(capture_samples %>% select(Sample, Method = MethodFactor, PairID), by = "Sample")
write_csv_safe(mds_df, "capture_mds_coordinates.csv")

p_mds <- ggplot(mds_df, aes(Dimension1, Dimension2, color = Method, group = PairID)) +
  geom_path(color = serum_neutral_text, linewidth = 0.65, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_palette[c("1", "2")]) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.12))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.12))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "MDS quality control: paired differential capture",
    subtitle = "Annotation-level TMM normalization; lines join three matched aliquot pairs",
    x = "Leading logFC dimension 1", y = "Leading logFC dimension 2", color = "Method"
  ) +
  serum_theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.margin = margin(8, 14, 8, 14))
if (pkg_has("ggrepel")) {
  p_mds <- p_mds + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Sample), seed = 42, size = 3.2,
    box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf, max.time = 2, show.legend = FALSE
  )
} else {
  p_mds <- p_mds + geom_text(aes(label = Sample), vjust = -0.85, size = 3.2, check_overlap = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE)
}
save_plot_nested(p_mds, "01_design_qc", "capture_mds.pdf", width = 8, height = 6.2, view = REPORT_VIEW)
```

显著结果表示在三个匹配分装中方向相对一致的技术性捕获差异；由于只有一个供体，不能将 FDR 解读为人群层面的生物学差异。
